title: Editor pairing and undo chips
description: Getting a pairing link and undoing a glow change from chat

console: animus create greeter name=greeter world=world x=-2.5 y=64 z=-9.5
animus create trader type=minecraft:llama name=trader world=world x=4.5 y=64 z=-9.5

beats.result: Manage selection opens on the greeter, Open in editor in the top row
the window closes; chat reads Pairing link ready, with [Open editor]
chat reads Set glowing to true on greeter, with [Undo]
the greeter now has a white glowing outline
chat reads Rolled back, and the greeter's outline is gone

closing: The pairing link is in chat, and Undo turned the glow off again
